parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const domains=Array.isArray(b.official_domains)?b.official_domains:[]; const candidates=Array.isArray(b.candidates)?b.candidates:[]; const cutoff=String(b.information_cutoff??''); if(!domains.length) throw new Error('At least one verified official domain is required'); if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cutoff)) throw new Error('Valid information_cutoff required'); const trusted=['nseindia.com','nsearchives.nseindia.com','bseindia.com','sebi.gov.in',...domains].map(d=>String(d).toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,'')); const match=(h,d)=>h===d||h.endsWith('.'+d); const admitted=[]; const rejected=[]; const seen=new Set(); for(const c of candidates){ try{ const u=new URL(String(c.url??'')); const host=u.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,''); const date=c.published_at?String(c.published_at):null; let reason=''; if(u.protocol!=='https:') reason='non_https'; else if(!trusted.some(d=>match(host,d))) reason='unverified_domain'; else if(!date) reason='missing_publication_date'; else if(date>cutoff) reason='post_cutoff'; else if(seen.has(u.href)) reason='duplicate'; if(reason){rejected.push({url:u.href,reason});continue;} seen.add(u.href); const sourceClass=match(host,'sebi.gov.in')?'regulator':(match(host,'nseindia.com')||match(host,'nsearchives.nseindia.com')||match(host,'bseindia.com'))?'exchange':'company_official'; const priority=sourceClass==='regulator'?3:sourceClass==='exchange'?2:1; admitted.push({source_id:'official-'+String(admitted.length+1).padStart(3,'0'),url:u.href,title:String(c.title??''),published_at:date,retrieved_at:new Date().toISOString(),source_class:sourceClass,priority}); }catch{rejected.push({url:String(c.url??''),reason:'invalid_url'});} } admitted.sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||String(b.published_at).localeCompare(String(a.published_at))); return [{json:{ticker:String(b.ticker??'').toUpperCase(),information_cutoff:cutoff,official_domains:domains,admitted,rejected,quality_control:{candidate_count:candidates.length,admitted_count:admitted.length,rejected_count:rejected.length,human_review_required:admitted.length===0}}}];
